verdict.rationale: GitBook is a SaaS docs platform with built-in AI features (AI Assistant, GitBook Agent, AI search), so a training opt-out or no-training data policy is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses whether customer content is used to train AI models or offers a way to opt out. The 'Authenticated access' and 'LLM optimizations' items cover reader access and making docs consumable by AI, not training-data controls.
